title: Mail
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Private detective Reiji Akiba can see the dead, who he believes reach us through odd coincidences, and he lays evil spirits to rest with a gun called Kagutsuchi (Dark Horse blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). A three-volume collection of episodic ghost stories by Housui Yamazaki; a Manga Bookshelf review describes spook-of-the-week tales mixing moral tales, campfire scares and urban legends, with murdered babies, vengeful lovers, drowning victims and gruesome imagery, and gives the Dark Horse rating as older teen/mature.
life_message: It suggests that the dead carry unfinished grief and wrongs, and that someone must face them so the living can be at peace.
